messages.subject: readdst error
parts:
Hi guys, trying the readdst package.
When runnng:

> sample.proj.dir <- "U:/whatever/"
> alcid.proj.file <- paste0(sample.proj.dir, "AlcidData")
> alcid.proj <- convert_project(alcid.proj.file)
Error in this_section[[tx$key]] <- tx$cmd : 
  object 'this_section' not found

I have attached the .dst file and data folder.

Francois

messages.author: 350dad0a615d36db
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] readdst error
parts:
Hi Francois, hi listfolk!

Thanks for trying out readdst! We still consider it experimental at the
moment but we're very happy to have folks try it out! :)

Looks like you found a bug! We don't parse all of the possible DISTANCE
commands at the moment and your project has 2 that we hadn't handled yet
("Assign Output" and "Assign Stats"). I've added some code to ignore
these (as we don't save these files with readdst like DISTANCE does).

I've pushed some changes to github, if you get the latest version from
there:

library(devtools)
install_github("DistanceDevelopment/readdst")

you should be able to run your analysis.

Please do let me know if you have further issues and thanks again for
trying it out.

cheers,
--dave
